
<style>
body {
  line-height: 0%;
}
.container {
  display: inline;
  margin: 0px;
  padding: 0px;
  width: fit-content;
}

.container > .heart {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 10%; /* adjust to control the size */
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    clip-path: shape(from 0% 0%,line to 0% 100%,arc to 100% 100%  of 1%,arc to 100% 0% of 1%);
    background: #cc333f;
    /*transition: transform 1s ease;*/
    transition: all 1s;
    transition-delay: 3s;
    margin: -1pt;

}
.container:hover > .heart,
.container > .heart:hover,
.container:active > .heart,
.container > .heart:active {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
    clip-path: shape(from 50% 91%,line to 90% 50%,arc to 50% 9%  of 1%,arc to 10% 50% of 1%);
    /* transition: transform 1s ease;*/
    transition: all 0.1s;
}
</style>
